system.description: Contested extended roll: thaumaturge's (Manipulation+Occult+Degree) vs. spirit's reflexive (Willpower+Essence). Each roll takes one minute and one casting. Target must spend 3 motes per roll or forfeit the contest. If the exorcist achieves net successes equal to (spirit's Essence + highest Virtue), the spirit must leave. Banishment: gods=1 hour, elementals=night and a day, demons=one week; extra successes double banishment period. Ghosts must return to Underworld; twice the successes lays them to rest permanently. Celestial Incarnae and greater beings can only be banished by a thaumaturge with equal permanent Essence.
